SELECT 
    p.sitelabel AS plant_name,
    p.cap_mw,
    p.goliveon,
    om.mtbfh,
    om.mttrh,
    om.maintcost,
    om.cleancost,
    om.replcost,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct' AS availability_pct,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh' AS energy_yield_kwh,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'capacity_factor_pct' AS capacity_factor_pct,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'instant_eff_pct' AS instant_eff_pct,
    a.alrtstate AS alert_state,
    a.alrtcnt,
    i.dqscore

JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops

LEFT JOIN alert a ON pr.snapkey = a.snapalrt
LEFT JOIN inspection i ON 1=1
LIMIT 5;

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_plant_performance_overview;
CREATE VIEW v_plant_performance_overview AS
SELECT 
    p.sitelabel AS plant_name,
    p.cap_mw,
    p.goliveon,
    om.mtbfh,
    om.mttrh,
    om.maintcost,
    om.cleancost,

    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'capacity_factor_pct' AS capacity_factor_pct,
    ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'instant_eff_pct' AS instant_eff_pct,
    a.alrtstate AS alert_state,
    a.alrtcnt,
    a.maintprio,
    a.replprio
FROM plants p
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (sitetie) snapkey, sitetie FROM plant_record ORDER BY sitetie, snapts DESC) lr ON p.sitekey = lr.sitetie
LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON lr.snapkey = om.snapops
LEFT JOIN electrical_performance ep ON lr.snapkey = ep.snaplink
LEFT JOIN alert a ON lr.snapkey = a.snapalrt;
